Fender
Studio Pro X

A free community expansion that gives you your own version of Fender Studio Pro 8.

FreeYour licensed copyLicensing untouchedOne-click uninstallVersion 1.2.0
Get it free on GitHub github.com/ferrerokush-png/fender-studio-pro-x

What it is

Ten packages that sit on top of the Studio Pro you already own.

Free, for everyone

No price, no account, no sign-up. Our own code, open under the MIT licence.

Your own licensed copy

It installs on your Studio Pro 8. No Fender files are shipped: skins are built on your PC from your own copy.

Licensing is never touched

Sign-in, activation, subscriptions and the store work exactly as before. Nothing here goes near them.

One-click uninstall

Hold Shift at start for stock, or run Uninstall and you are back to plain Studio Pro. Or remove just one package.

Heads up

These mods are completely vibe-coded. I’m not a programmer. I built all of this with AI and I honestly don’t know what I’m doing, so expect bugs and things that break. Back up your songs first, use it at your own risk, and if anything acts up, run the uninstaller to go back to stock.

Fender Studio Pro X02

Same program, same songs. A calmer place to work.

Fender Studio Pro X03

Liquid Glass

A dark, frosted skin for the whole window, with light that stays in the background.

  • 8 accents, 4 presets. 32 looks, switched from the Skins page.
  • One soft light. Your accent colour, from the top left. The Browser has its own glow. Or pick Cool zones.
  • Glass tint. From no tint to strong glass. No film grain.
  • Colour where it helps. The accent marks selection and sliders. Record, mute, solo and meters keep their colours.
  • Every corner. Toolbar, transport, inspector, mixer, editors. Track headers keep Studio Pro’s own shapes.
Fender Studio Pro XPackage 01 · Skins    04

Make your own skin from one short text file.

Start from a base, list only what you want different, run one command. No coding.

# themes/ocean.toml [theme] name = "Ocean" base = "liquidglass" swatches = ["#0F1012", "#1E1F23", "#7C7E86", "#3AC7E0"] [accent] hue = 189 [shape] button = 10

Fender Studio Pro XPackages 06 and 07    08

AI Lab. Runs on your own PC.

A new Browser tab with four sections, part of the AI tools package. Nothing is uploaded unless you add a key for an online service yourself.

Generate makes music from a prompt with a local model. Default models are MIT or Apache licensed. Needs Studio Pro 8 (full version) and an NVIDIA GPU is strongly recommended. AI Lab always comes with the chat assistant & bridge: its Add to song button uses it.

Fender Studio Pro XPackage 10 · AI tools    09

An assistant that knows your song.

A chat panel in the Studio Assistant slot, talking to the AI model you choose with your own key. Part of the AI tools package.

  • It reads the open song first, then answers or makes the change.
  • Every edit can be undone with Edit > Undo.
  • Stays on your PC. The bridge listens on this PC only. Nothing is sent until you add a key.
  • Any MCP assistant can drive Studio Pro through the same bridge.
  • Comes with AI Lab. Its Add to song button uses the same bridge, so the two are installed together.

Fender Studio Pro XPackages 01 and 08    11

New in 1.1.0

Polished, piece by piece.

  • Smooth backgrounds. The film grain is gone, everywhere.
  • One light. A single soft light in your accent colour, top left. The Browser gets its own glow from its bottom edge.
  • Cool zones. A second choice in a new Lighting row on the Skins page: a quiet cool light in each panel, the song grid left unlit. The newest part, so the least tested.
  • Glass tint that sticks. The slider saves properly now, and its top end is about three times the default.
  • Stock track headers. Studio Pro’s own shapes, meter and colour effect. Plain neutral rows when track colours are off.
  • Transport. The tiles stay clean whatever you show or hide.
  • Scrollbars. The handle stays visible at every zoom.
  • Mixer. Quieter plug-in names, bypassed plug-ins clearly dimmed. Channel colour fills the whole strip, so the Skins page no longer asks.
  • Session library. Rename now works on the home page too.
  • Splash. The version number sits small in the window corner.

1.2.0 adds a faster Sound search that plays MIDI files, and a Home page Quick start card. Pictures were taken before 1.1.0, so details differ.

Fender Studio Pro X13

Install in three steps.

1

Close and unzip

Close Studio Pro. Unzip the pack anywhere. Each package has its own folder and a short README.

2

Run Install

Double-click Install.bat and tick the packages you want, with switches under each. It adds what a package needs and shows a summary before it changes anything.

3

Build and pick

The skins are built on your PC from your own Studio Pro in 2 to 4 minutes. Then start it and pick a skin in Options > Skins.

Needs Windows 10 or 11, your own licensed Studio Pro 8 (tested on 8.1.2), Python 3.11+ with numpy, pillow, fonttools and brotli, and ImageMagick 7. The installer checks and tells you what is missing. It asks for administrator rights once, for the loader file. AI tools: AI Lab always comes with the chat assistant & bridge; Better stems is off at first (large download, it asks first).

Fender Studio Pro X14

Back to stock, any time.

Shift

For one start

Hold Shift while Studio Pro starts. You get the stock look for that start.

Uninstall.bat

Remove everything

Run the top-level one and Studio Pro is exactly stock again. Any file a package replaced comes back from the copy kept at install.

packages\NN-name\Uninstall.bat

Remove one package

Each package has its own. Packages that need it go too, and it tells you before it does anything.

Install.bat again

Change a switch

Run Install.bat again and untick the switch or the package. The summary shows what will be removed.

Your settings and songs are never moved. Saved views, favourites and folders are kept.

Fender Studio Pro X15

Our promise

Respect for the program, and for the people who make it.

  • Licensing stays untouched. No changes to sign-in, activation, subscriptions or the store. Ever.
  • No Fender files shipped. No skin files, images, fonts or program code. Skins are built on your PC from your own copy.
  • No surprises online. Only news, the artist card, YouTube, model downloads and keys you add go online, and each has an off switch.
  • Every change can be undone. Where a package replaces a stock file (the Moises tab, the SoundCloud panel), the original is kept and Uninstall puts it back.
  • Open and free. Our code is MIT licensed. Third-party models and tools keep their own licences.
  • Your projects come first. Settings and songs stay where they are. Back up as usual.
